images.alt_en: Illustration inspired by the story: The Order was fourteen pages long and gave thirty days, and on the third morning Illuminara laid her answer across the Harbour Office counter on a single sheet.
images.alt_sl: Ilustracija po zgodbi: Odredba je bila dolga štirinajst strani in je določala trideset dni, tretje jutro pa je Illuminara svoj odgovor razgrnila čez pult pristaniškega urada na enem samem listu.
